documents.text: ## The base path of `overrides` and `ignorePatterns` has changed when using the `--config`/`--ignore-path` options Up until now, ESLint has resolved the following paths relative to the directory path of the _entry_ configuration file: - Configuration files (`.eslintrc.*`) - relative paths in the `overrides[].files` setting - relative paths in the `overrides[].excludedFiles` setting - paths which start with `/` in the `ignorePatterns` setting - Ignore files (`.eslintignore`) - paths which start with `/` Starting in ESLint v7.0.0, configuration files and ignore files passed to ESLint using the `--config path/to/a-config` and `--ignore-path path/to/a-ignore` CLI flags, respectively, will resolve from the current working directory rather than the file location. This allows for users to utilize shared plugins without having to install them directly in their project. **To address:** Update the affected paths if you are using a configuration or ignore file via the `--config` or `--ignore-path` CLI options. **Related issue(s):** [RFC37](https://github.com/eslint/rfcs/blob/master/designs/2019-changing-base-path-in-config-files-that-cli-options-specify/README.md), [#12887](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/pull/12887)

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
